messages.author: 6edda707edeae569
messages.subject: multiple observers
parts:
I am trying to model for 2 observers who sometimes did independent surveys at the same site at the same time, but mostly visited sites alone.  Sites were not visited on all 6 sampling occasions.  For example, at site BB1:
occ 1: both obs1 and obs2 completed independent surveys
occ 2: obs1
occ 3: obs2
occ 4: not surveyed
occ 5: both obs1 and obs2 completed independent surveys
occ 6: not surveyed

I'm unsure how to format my data for unmarked.  Does anyone know of a tutorial that shows this specific example?  Thanks!

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] multiple observers
parts:
by independent surveyes do you mean independent double observer sampling ? Or unreconciled independent counts? If the former, we covered what I think is a similar situation in the workshops last year. Go to the document linked below and start on page 4. This dealt with a capture-recapture protocol with T=3 periods but T=2 for some sample units, and we used missing values and the piFun argument to mix the protocols.  I think you can use similar ideas to resolve your situation although I believe the problem is not necessarily straightforward.
If you mean the latter (just 2 unreconciled independent counts) then there isn't anything special about this case that shouldn't work directly in pcount() and related functions. (i.e., if only one observer sampled then the other observer has a missing value)
 
https://sites.google.com/site/unmarkedinfo/home/workshops/patux2012/slides/Slides_Multimix.pdf?attredirects=0&d=1
